text:
alex: heads up — running into a weird resolution error when spinning up the edge sample-app (vercel dev) inside the monorepo with pnpm workspaces. runtime error: "Error: Cannot find module './dist/index.js' from '/workspace/sample-app'"

maria: ugh, that sounds like an exports/hoist thing. can you paste the sdk package.json and the sample-app import?

alex: sure — sdk package.json snippet:
```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/inference-sdk",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs.js",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js",
      "import": "./dist/index.mjs"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "type": "module"
}
```

alex: sample-app just does `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk'`

oliver: two quick calls: 1) pnpm uses symlinks inside the workspace and some edge/dev servers don't preserve symlink resolution the same as node. 2) exports + type:module mismatch can make bundlers pick the wrong entry. Vercel's edge dev uses esbuild/rollup-ish resolver which follows the package root, not the symlink target. :facepalm:

tj: also tsserver/vite sometimes resolve to the package.json in the root of the workspace, not the package dir behind the symlink, so `exports` can block deep imports. try adding an explicit subpath in exports for the exact path you import.

yasmin: short workaround that worked for me previously: change sample-app's vite config to alias the package to the local src: `alias: { '@redwood/inference-sdk': path.resolve(__dirname, '../packages/sdk/src') }` — not ideal but unblocks local dev. alternatively build the sdk before `vercel dev`.

alex: tried alias — works. but that's annoying for onboarding (new hires won't know this). i also tried `node --preserve-symlinks` locally and that changed behavior but vercel dev doesn't expose that flag.

ci-bot: quick repro in CI: using `pnpm -w install` in a clean container + `vercel dev` yields 1) resolver error, 2) esbuild: "Could not resolve "@redwood/inference-sdk"".

maria: propose we: 1) add an ESM dev entry in the sdk package root (e.g., `dev.mjs`) that re-exports src with relative paths, and include an easy `pnpm workspace:dev` script in sample-app that sets VITE alias; 2) document the hoisting gotcha in devex docs; 3) add a CI smoke test that runs `vercel dev` or `wrangler dev` in a container to catch regressions.

oliver: agree + we should tighten the package `exports` mapping to include `./dev` or `./src` only for workspace mode so bundlers can find the source without changing `main` for published packages. maybe a small script that patches package.json when running `pnpm start` in repo root.

alex: sounds good. i'll open a short PR with the alias script + docs and a follow-up PR to add export dev mappings. thanks for the quick help :thumbsup:

yasmin: nit — add an example in onboarding checklist: "If you get module not found for @redwood/* in edge dev, run `pnpm --filter sample-app dev:link` (will set alias)."

alex: added task in PR description. marking as blocked on a small confirm from eng-runtime about not breaking deploys.

ci-bot: build/test note: add `pnpm --filter sample-app test:dev-resolve` to CI matrix (fast smoke).

oliver: also ping runtime team, they might want to consider `preserveSymlinks` semantics in our local dev containers.

alex: thanks all — will drop the PR link once ready.
